items.title: Live: PM to address nation tonight on response to Middle East war
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese will deliver an address to the nation tonight as the local impact stemming from the Iran war continues to intensify. Follow live.

items.title: PM to urge Australians to 'play their part' in Iran response
items.description: The prime minister's office says Anthony Albanese will address the nation on TV tonight, urging Australians to save fuel for areas and industries that "most need it".

items.title: The uncomfortable truth about a recession is that we could already be in one
items.description: The government is urging people to carry on as normal, despite fuel shortages, because it knows that panic will make matters worse. But it may need to consider more drastic economic intervention.

items.title: Hopes for an end to Iran war briefly had markets euphoric, but there's a plot twist
items.description: If you had woken up today and heard someone say Wall Street's tech sector rose more than 3 per cent overnight, you would expect it to be promptly followed by "April Fools' Day".

items.title: After two days, police formally identify Dezi Freeman as man shot dead
items.description: Victoria Police have officially confirmed that the person shot dead by officers at a property in Victoria's north-east on Monday morning was fugitive Dezi Freeman.

items.title: Live: Trump says US will leave Iran 'very soon' and estimates 'two weeks, maybe three'
items.description: US President Donald Trump says the US will leave Iran "very soon" has given an estimate of "two weeks, maybe three". Follow live.

items.title: Mine may be shut down amid money laundering allegations, bikie claims
items.description: The Tasmanian government has taken steps to revoke the operating licence of one of the state's biggest mining operations, after being warned it was allegedly used as a "vehicle for money laundering" and former owners were associated with underworld figures.

items.title: One of Australia's biggest 'giveaway' clubs has its licence cancelled
items.description: RS Rewards claims to have given away more than $10 million worth of cars, houses and cash. But its licence has just been cancelled.

items.title: 'It's tragic': Hundreds to be impacted after Seafood giant folds
items.description: Australia's largest wild-caught prawn operation is to close its doors after 60 years in business, impacting hundreds of workers and devastating a Queensland community.

items.title: Taylor Swift faces trademark lawsuit over The Life of a Showgirl album
items.description: Las Vegas performer Maren Wade says the name and imagery of Taylor Swift's latest album are too close to those of her show, Confessions of a Showgirl.

items.title: 'We are an expert': How Lebanon's airport keeps running despite Israeli strikes
items.description: Beirut-Rafic Hariri Airport, Lebanon's gateway to the world, is still operating even as Israel bombards its surroundings.

items.title: Live: ASX jumps on back of massive Wall St rally amid war end hopes
items.description: Wall Street ends a weak month with a massive gain, as investors eye a possible end to US military action in Iran, and Australian shares follow. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Spurs fans protest over new manager as post-Postecoglou woes deepen
items.description: Tottenham fan groups voice opposition to newly appointed manager Roberto De Zerbi over his previous public support for Mason Greenwood, a player who faced charges of attempted rape and assault.

items.title: Socceroos headliners shine, but will the experimentation pay off at World Cup?
items.description: The Socceroos are done with experimenting, but now need to find the winning formula with the World Cup quickly approaching.

items.title: Travel quiz: Get out your passport and see if you can beat our quiz
items.description: Which is Australia’s oldest Luna Park? And where would you find Elvis Presley’s mansion?

items.title: Bluey's lead composer on helping kids fall in love with music
items.description: A new orchestral Bluey album is out. Lead composer Joff Bush talks about classical music, storytelling and inspiring kids to love music.

items.title: This controversial rom-com starring Zendaya is one of the best movies of the year
items.description: On the surface, A-listers Zendaya and Robert Pattinson's new film seems like a regular rom-com. That's exactly what director Kristoffer Borgli wants you to think.

items.title: Judge halts Trump's White House demolition and ballroom project
items.description: A federal court has ordered the Trump administration to suspend work on a $400 million ballroom on the site of the demolished East Wing of the White House, barring construction from proceeding without congressional approval.

items.title: House prices rise everywhere besides Sydney and Melbourne
items.description: There is a significant divide between property price growth in major cities as buyers weigh up interest rate hikes and geopolitical tensions.

items.title: Man jailed for stabbing wife to death eligible for parole in two weeks
items.description: Dennis Naroldol, 59, has been sentenced to four years in prison over the fatal stabbing of his wife outside the Darwin DoubleTree Hilton in 2023 and will be eligible for parole in two weeks after time served.

items.title: Anger at developer's plan to build $10m mansion on illegally cleared land
items.description: A property developer who illegally cut down hundreds of native trees has lodged a new plan to build a lavish $10 million, six-bedroom mansion in Sydney's south.

items.title: Star completes sale of Queen's Wharf stake to Hong Kong partners
items.description: Star Entertainment confirms it has relinquished its stake in the Destination Brisbane Consortium to Hong Kong partners Chow Tai Fook Enterprises and Far East Consortium.

items.title: Police allege murder victim's body was set alight after death
items.description: A 37-year-old man has been arrested and charged with murder a week after burning human remains were found at a Dimbulah property.

items.title: Phone ban in classrooms extended to include smartwatches, headphones
items.description: Victorian students in public and private schools will be banned from wearing smartwatches with internet connectivity and using headphones in classrooms from next year after the government announced an extension of the device ban in schools.

items.title: Farmers think outside the box as rising fuel costs add to drought woes
items.description: Farmers are turning to roadside grazing, selling up stock, and, in one case, shipping cattle to an island to navigate the drought and the rising cost of diesel.
